field_checks.summary: Primary XML/PDF Table 1 and section 3.4 support one positive MIC record for purified SM07 against Pseudomonas aeruginosa ATCC27853 at 4 ug/mL, and the final positive activity row matches that value/unit/target. Coverage is not publication-grade because the same source table's SM07 non-detect/selectivity rows are reduced to generic excluded ND cells without field-level target/treatment/exactness coverage.

The packet has zero linked authoritative article/assay/sequence/literature rows, and the final correctly leaves the fallback SM07 group unresolved with sequence value None and no source_verified database record. However the current strict acceptance artifact reports 8 hard recursive_non_source_locator_reference findings in database artifacts, so the database layer cannot be publication-grade until those source_locator fields are repaired.

Every current paper final JSON and packet final mirror was reviewed. Paper and packet mirrors are byte/semantic equal for database_record_verification, activity_toxicity_evidence, mechanism_ontology_record, and review_report; packet mechanism_evidence is an alias of the same mechanism record. Final counts are activity 1, toxicity 1, database audit 1, mechanism claims 4, review rework targets 0. Live rework_requests.jsonl has 0 rows, matching reported open_rework_ticket_count 0.

Mechanism evidence classes are scientifically conservative: no direct mechanism is promoted, antimicrobial activity remains phenotype_supported, sequence/domain analysis remains computational_only, and discussion-level permeability/muralytic language remains inferred. The mechanism layer still fails field-level provenance because mechanism_claims[3].source_locator includes a work artifact locator rather than only primary-source locators.

Paper identity matches the primary XML/PDF: PMCID PMC13025223, DOI 10.3390/cimb48030318, PMID 41899469, title on SM07 phage-derived lytic protein. SM07 name and ORF context are source-located, but no full plain one-letter source sequence or linked authoritative database record is present; no final object contains both sequence and sequence_length for residue-count validation. This is preserved as unresolved and not ingest-ready.

The positive MIC row preserves value/unit directly with no conversion, and the qualitative toxicity row is marked not_convertible. Locator integrity fails because database artifacts use packet/report paths as source_locator values and the mechanism final includes a work: locator in a mechanism claim source_locator. These are recursive authority/provenance failures, independent of green semantic/publication gates.

Recursive authority is not false: the current strict acceptance audit has strict_worker_run_hard_finding_count 8, all recursive_non_source_locator_reference, and acceptance_ready_for_paper_level_source_review is false. The fallback release boundary is preserved because authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready is false and fallback rows are not promoted to source_verified or portal/authoritative ingest.

No cross-database conflict can be resolved because linked authoritative rows are empty. The current finals preserve cautions for absent authoritative DBAASP linkage, fallback rows as candidate-only, and no standalone supplements. These cautions are appropriate but cannot neutralize the hard recursive locator findings.

The staged paper supplementary directory and packet raw supplementary_original directory are readable and empty. XML/PDF review and packet extraction show no supplementary-material/app/media assets, supplementary_index has 0 files, supplementary_text has 0 rows, supplementary_tables has 0 tables, archive_manifest has 0 archives, and extraction_errors has 0 rows.

The primary source supports qualitative toxicity coverage: section 3.5/Figure 6 report no significant toxicity in Vero cells at 62.5 ug/mL, and the final records this as qualitative/not_convertible. Selectivity coverage is incomplete because Table 1's non-detect SM07 rows for the other tested strains are not represented with field-level target, treatment, value, and exact-vs-approximate/ND status; Figure 6 also needs an explicit exact-text versus approximate-graph status if quantitative toxicity is retained or rejected.

The fields $/authoritative_database_linkage/source_locator and $/citation_traceability/source_locator point to packet/report files rather than primary-source or database-row locators, while the only database candidate sequence is the placeholder None and linked authoritative row counts are zero. This prevents publication-grade PASS even though fallback rows are not promoted.

The current final collapses these into excluded_or_unresolved_candidates with raw ND and row_has_target booleans, leaving several SM07 rows without field-level target species/strain, treatment, value status, and exact-vs-approximate/ND status. required_actions: Represent all Table 1 SM07 test rows, either as activity/selectivity records or as structured exclusions that preserve target species, strain, treatment, raw activity code, MIC value or ND, source cell locator, and exactness status.
